en: A dusk or early evening waterside scene showing a dense cluster of boats or floating houses in a harbor, surrounded by dark hills and calm water reflecting the fading light of the sky. Neon signs in Chinese characters and English glow on the shore, including one prominently reading "China Motor – Palace," indicating an urban waterfront, possibly a historic Chinese or Hong Kong harbor with a boat-dwelling community.
